t: Collect fox fur and crocodile skins in Al Rihat Ruins.

They say House Tristesse used to be rich and famous.

Alas, it's no longer the case. To put it bluntly, we are poor as dirt. All our wealth was either stolen or lost in Sleepy Grove.

That's why we need your help. Our artisans are ready to start working. They can make expensive clothing for sale. All they need from you is material.

I know there are foxes in the area... And even crocodiles.

Their skins and hides should do nicely. We'll find a way to repay you.
These materials should help our artisans fulfill lots of new commissions. Thank you.
Defeat hornets and collect honeycombs in Al Rihat Ruins.

There's a beautiful legend that dates back to the Battle for Beauty when the elven king met two Forestfolk Warriors in the forest and asked for their heather honey recipe. The king never learned the recipe, but our House has its own tricks and secrets. Local bees gather sweet nectar from flowers that grow only in these parts.

I want to resume the production of this wonderful drink. We could use your help - we don't have enough people to send them out to look for hives of giant bees. It's also very dangerous. And you're a great hero. Please collect honey for us!
Honey is collected. I hope the bees are fine. This should last us a while, but I'll ask you to collect more when we run out.
Eliminate the bats in Al Rihat Ruins.

Bats are nasty and noisy creatures, and there are too many of them in these lands...

The House de Doucer and their vampires are probably to blame. They are the ones who like to keep these animals as pets. Even though there's a spider on their coat of arms. Actually, there are also plenty of spiders around here, too...

Bats have plagued Danas himself - if we don't reduce their population now, I fear that in the future we'll have to deal with swarms of those nasty creatures. That's why I task you with launching a preemptive strike and exterminating as many bats as possible.
Are you done with the bats?
We've dealt with this threat, but who knows what the next day will bring?
Use the magic amulet to prepare as much bull meat as possible.

Before Tugarin and the Blight came, Al Rihat was a blessed land where the coexistence of humans and elves led to flourishing trade and prosperity.
 One of the most valuable resources of this land were herds of cows that grazed in the local meadows. Alas, during the invasion by the Orcs, many shepherds were killed, and the cows that survived fled into the forests.
 However, my scouts report that a lost herd has recently appeared in the area. These feral bulls will be very useful to us. I will give you a magic amulet that will help you cook many wonderful steaks. We can't survive on blood alone, right?
Are you done with the task?
Great, now we have enough supplies to last us a while.
Defeat harpies in Al Rihat Ruins.

Ah, harpies.

You know, the elves nurture a longstanding ambition to domesticate these wild creatures. I can't say our attempts were completely unsuccessful... as you know, many demonologists have them as their companions.

It's an old argument: who is better in the art of love, lamias or harpies? Ahem.

But never mind that! Alas, harpies that live nearby are completely witless and useless creatures. They'd rather wreck and defile things than embrace Beauty. With a heavy heart, I must ask you to eliminate them.
Are you done with the harpies? Alas, to build up a flower bed, you need to weed it regularly.
Collect hydra acid in Al Rihat Ruins

Our house is famous for its arts and artisans.

Alchemy is also one of our talents - it helps us work with metal. It requires acid which is a rare resource in our time.

It's a good thing there's a pack of hydras nearby. Their blood is very caustic, so I can separate acid from it which can be used for metalwork and other purposes.

You will also make our lakes and ponds safer.
Oh, what a good acid. Thank you, that's exactly what we need.
Defeat ogres in Al Rihat Ruins.

The ancient Lulleaguin Stronghold stood to the south of our estate.

Alas, it fell when the Blight began. We were no longer here and couldn't help.

One of the Great Trees grew inside the fortress, guarded by the Protective Circle.

The druids established a sanitary cordon and shut the gates. But there were refugees seeking help, and the Keepers let them in. One of them must have carried the Blight. Everyone who stood guard here died in a terrible siege: forest monsters on the outside and blighted treants on the inside.

But the troubles of Lulleaguin did not end there: soon after the stronghold was liberated, it was occupied by ogres.

Their leader was a vile man-eater who used to serve elf sirens. We're not talking about them, I'm ashamed for my brethren who decided to treat themselves to someone else's flesh. As for the ogres, here's my task: get inside the fortress and show no mercy. Tensess help us, we'll take it back and station our own garrison there. Then we'll try and heal the Great Tree.
Ogres who have tasted flesh will never stop craving it. So don't feel bad about killing them.
Eliminate the deer in Al Rihat Ruins.

Oh, there's another problem: deer. These animals migrate from the forests to the astral shores not far from the Lulleaguin stronghold. I understand why this is happening - it's no longer safe in the woods, since the wilds are full of all kinds of predatory beasts.

But it's not great for us. The thing is, deer gnaw at the bark of unique fruit trees that grow near the fortress. If this continues, we will lose them.

So I task you with reducing the deer population. It's a harsh measure, but we're out of options.
Are you done with the deer?
Have you dealt with the deer?
Eliminate the Satyrs in Al Rihat Ruins

It's a shame about the Satyrs. Once upon a time they lived in peace, even traded with others. Then marauders attacked them - they ravaged their village and desecrated their idols.

The horned ones got angry and decided to take revenge - on us, vampires from the House de Doucer; then the bandits, and everyone else. And it's impossible to explain to them who their real enemy is. The thing is, to our misfortune, they found a cellar with stocks of "green wine" that some Kanian merchant stored in the fortress.

Now it's nonstop revelry and drinking, and a drunken Satyr is worse than any Ogre - after a few drinks, they are ready to skewer anyone. Now they are bullying the Ogres. What if they show up here? It's going to be a real problem. That's why we need to make a pre-emptive attack...
Did you manage to stop the drunken revelry?
Great, Satyrs won't bother us anymore.
Collect Auk hides in Al Rihat Ruins.

Greetings!

We were ordinary hunters before the Blight struck... Now we're tasked with hunting down blighted creatures before they get too close to settlements. Queen Catherina herself is paying us.

Right now we're hunting multiped wolves called Auks. But we're short-handed. Help us if you can, kill a few wolves and bring us their hides. You'll be rewarded, of course.
Ugh, those wolves have impressive jaws. Dreadful. Give me the hides, we'll send them to the Queen.
Defeat beasts in Al Rihat Ruins.

What are those things? Where did they come from? We haven't seen them before the Blight. Maybe it's a mutated grave worm or hamster, who can tell anymore? But you will sense it when they are close: they smell like death. And if you fight them, make sure to clean your wounds thoroughly, even the tiniest cuts. Their claws are not just razor-sharp, but also venomous, and even magic can't heal those wounds!
Collect souls of Midnight Dwellers in Al Rihat Ruins using a special crystal.

Al Rihat Ruins and the Blight cut these lands off from the central allod. Ships maintain contact with the capital, but it's costly and they don't sail as often as we'd like.

And recently a summoner suggested another method of communication - ghostly owls. They say Gibberlings in Siveria have been using them for ages.

But we don't have many owls around here, just a few Midnight Dwellers. I'll give you a special summoning crystal - you need to collect souls of Midnight Dwellers. The summoner will bring them back to life so they can serve us.
We need our communications - who knows where the next crisis might come from? Without news, we won't know anything.
Obtain Galactic Deer Horns in Al Rihat Ruins.

Six gods bless you!

We are simple hunters. In battle we use ordinary bows and arrows enchanted by the elves. But if there is no bow, there is nothing to enchant!

So we need expendable materials, and what makes the best bow? Horns and tendons. We still have plenty of tendons, but we're running of horns. Please be so kind as to get a few horns for us? The best ones are those of Blighted deer known as Galactic deer.
How is it going with the horns?
Great, it's a good bow material that we will definitely need.
Catch Blighted Rats in Al Rihat Ruins.

Hey! We received a very unusual "order".

There is a city on Umoir - Glimor. A bunch of smart people and sages sit around there, coming up with all sorts of things. This is what they wrote:

"Instruction: catch blighted rats and deliver them to the Kremengor laboratory. At least a dozen, preferably more."

What's that supposed to mean? Those rats are vicious... Well, what can we do? We have to obey, otherwise they will leave us here without equipment and provisions.

Help me out, please?
Now that's some strange order! What's next, catching fleas?
Great, it means help from Glimor will arrive on schedule...
Defeat mosquitos in Al Rihat Ruins.

Want to hear a riddle? What's the weakest but the most vicious blighted creature?

Mosquitos! They were intolerable before, but now it's a nightmare. There's a flooded river near the Foremother's Temple. It turned the area into a swamp, and now you can't set foot there unless you want to be eaten alive.

So if you encounter any mosquitos, kill them.
Fewer gnats, fewer problems. That's what my grandfather used to say.
Eliminate the Bear Mice in Al Rihat Ruins

The most ferocious creature in the area is the Bear Mouse. There are few hunters brave enough to face one.

Fortunately, we drove them out of the ruins. We hoped it was the end of it... but no, the remaining creatures are lurking around Crystal Peak...

It's hard to say what they're doing there, but our hunters are too scared to set foot in the area.

So if you're up to it, we'll be forever grateful.
Did you kill the Bear Mice? Great, how did you manage that?
Eliminate the Mutant Toads and procure rainbow flowers in Al Rihat Ruins.

And now a request from mages. Miracle workers, curse them.

They need a special flower that grows near the local river. It's all well and good, but the area is crawling with Mutant Toads.

Everyone knows about werewolves and werebears, but Mutant Toads is something unique to Umoir. I hear you can't find them anywhere else.

And apparently they need these flowers, too. I have no idea why, but when you pick a flower, a Mutant Toad immediately pops up and attacks you. So we can't do this without you. Help us out!
Oh, those sorcerers... First they need flowers, then eyes, then some other nasty thing... Thank you for your help.
Eliminate the Haregons in Al Rihat Ruins.

Something happened here once. We're all battling the creatures of the Blight, killing them as best we can. Somehow they lured a whole pack of Haregons to an island, just downstream of the beaver dam. We figured we'd demolish the dam, the wave will flood the island, and the Haregons will drown.

So we did it. Then went to take a look... And there was... this crazed wizard called Mazay who was sitting in his boat and pulling the Haregons out of the water one by one! There you have it. A protector of nature, damn it.

The men cuss at him, but he doesn't give a hoot, just keeps saving the critters.

That's why there are so many Haregons around here now. Since we couldn't handle it, you'll have to do it.
Well? Did you save the hares from themselves?
Excellent. I'll deal with Mazay later.
Eliminate the ghosts in Al Rihat Ruins

We have a lot of different kinds of ghosts, poltergeists, wights, wraiths, phantoms, phantasms, and other undead here... And the reason for this is simple:

When the walls of Al Rihat fell, Tugarin's horde did not spare anyone - the elderly, children, or women. The massacre was so terrible that the victims can't find peace to this day. Because of all the anger and sorrow, there is a lot of strength in them: if one of them touches you, you will float away to the astral plane! If you are not scared, help them find peace.
So deal with them - but do try to be respectful about it. They're not some otherworldly monsters - who knows, maybe my great-grandma is wandering around somewhere.

Well, we were able to put them to rest for a while...

So if there's something strange in our neighborhood, who we're gonna call?

You!
Defeat enemies of the Guardian Ring in Al Rihat Ruins.

I'm a representative of the Guardian Ring - the Keepers who are trying to heal this land. I'm also a member of House de Delice that wants to help our brethren who have become vampires.

The Guardian Ring of Al Rihat helps maintain the balance of life in these parts. We need help dealing with troublemakers and aggressive beasts.

If you help us, my friend, the Guardian Ring will not forget it!
Well done. The Ring thanks you.
Defeat enemies of House Tristesse in Al Rihat Ruins.

By the highest decree, House Tristesse ordered to reward Al Rihat restoration efforts. Any actions towards the improvement of our House's livelihood will be rewarded as well.

You will receive new instructions every day. They will keep you busy.
Defeat Hunters' enemies in Al Rihat Ruins.

There are so many animals in Al Rihat! Hunters help feed the local people and support those in need. We've got so much work to do! Your help will be highly appreciated.

Come back for a new task every day!
Excellent job! Our hunting society is grateful to you.
Light 8 lamps along the road to the mountain top within the given time.

Oh! What a misfortune!

All the lamps on the path have gone out because of the Frozen Spirits and their ice-cold breath! What if someone goes up that path, stumbles and falls down? Oh, I don't even want to think about it!

Can you give me hand? I'm so scared of the Frozen Spirits, and you don't seem to fear anything at all! I will give you a great reward for your help.

And please, be fast.
You just need to relight the lamps. I will reward you generously!
What would I do without you? Thank you! Here is your reward!
Examine the crime scene, question the witnesses, and track down the killer.

I'm sorry I am disturbing you in your off-time, but we are in trouble... Two men were killed last night, and so brutally I doubt they will ever resurrect. I reckon it wasn't just a regular drunken brawl.

The bodies were terribly disfigured, and there are practically no leads. The guards will tell you more.

They found the bodies near the northern wall, so you should go there. This is a dreadful incident indeed...
Here comes our hero! I hope this time you will first do some thinking and question people before you go and play hero.

Whoa, I can't believe my eyes!

Someone managed to fuse human flesh with that of the Architects, and instill life in that hybrid creature! It's such a shame we couldn't catch him alive. I am afraid these remains won't tell us much, but I will still try to learn what I can. I bet this thing wasn't created by the Architects.
Obtain Architects' wrecks near the Bee Ravine and hand them to Evdokia Bershanska.

I have yet no idea what this creature is, and why it killed harmless drunkards. I really doubt it tried to promote healthy lifestyle.

The jigsaws aren't falling in their places for now. I can't see the spells they used to bring this monster to life.

I think I need more tissue samples for analysis. Could you please bring me some pieces of Architects? Few of them can still be found on the Split Hill. Hand the samples to Bershanska - she will deliver them to me in an instant!

So that was you fiddling around with the Architects' wrecks on the east! My girls saw you. I will deliver the package, don't worry.

And where are all the rest? Should we wait for them?
Find the "odd fighters" in the east side on the Split Hill.

What do you mean, who? My girls saw a dozen of other Alliance fighters, going through Architects' remains to the east from Fractal. And then you came and asked me to deliver the wrecks to the city. I thought you were from the same troop!

So you don't know who they are? This is very strange. Nobody is supposed to be on the Bee Ravine right now. We need to check on those black diggers...
Who are those soldiers who dig through the Architects' wrecks on the east? This seems odd...
So those are the bastards who had deserted to the enemy?! Oh I will grind them to dust! I will send a whole squadron to eliminate them!
Hey, what's your detachment? A secret Alliance operation is taking place here! I order you to leave the territory, or we will have to use force!
What?! We warned you - guys, let's get that rat now!

Wait! Wait! I will tell you everything!

The Prophet! The Prophet told us to come here from the valley. He said that before our soul Transcends, we need to Ascend our bodies. For that, we needed some parts of those who used to be so close to the Perfectness! Everyone who wants to become an Initiate, needs to obtain those parts with their own hands. I swear we mean no harm! You just don't understand... The Order is the future! The future of whole Sarnaut! You all are servants of Chaos, and you will just keep on bringing more and more wars and destruction to our world!

Why don't you understand that?!

You should go back to Eladia and tell her that she's not the only one who is interested in the Architects' secrets. This Prophet will cause a lot of trouble, I can feel that... And there's also Hoof and his bandits - they are not going to make it any easier.
Oh... Where have you been?! The lab was attacked! Eladia is gone, and the remains of the monster disappeared along with her!

Fate prevails over everyone, even gods and demiurges. The All-Mother is also subject to its unstoppable power. Who knows what's in store?

If you were destined to go to Eden, it was inevitable.
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t: So, what do you have to say?

Is it so? Ah, I don't like looking into the past - makes my head hurt too much!

Wait, let me concentrate...

...

I can see! Some people... And something big... and evil... There are charms on it, so I can't see it clearly, but I can feel its aura... They are screaming... Eladia looks back... Flash of light - three of them fall down... Oh god... They killed Eladia!

...

Ah, no... She's alive. But I can't see her Thread... What is this? A Portal? They carry her by the arms... And they're carrying what's left of the monster....

...

I can't do this anymore!
h: Say that the dead men were fanatics

t: Examine the lab, talk to Unn, and start searching for Eladia.

I have no idea where she'd gone. Eladia used to tell everyone to stay away while she was tinkering with all that magic stuff. This time, she was working on her sorcery, too. But then a patrol squad which was walking by her lab heard some noise and voices... When they broke in, there was nobody inside - only a couple of bodies and smoking ruins.

I don't know even what to think... By the way, one of the dead men seems familiar to me!
I have a feeling that Eladia is alive. Though I have no idea where do we look for her!
The Portal ruins seem very old, but the footprints next to it indicate that someone was using it quite recently. And my guess is that only fanatics would have dared to use such an old Portal.
Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City.
The letter says that you should visit the Iron City immediately and meet Ivan Chelezny.
Greetings! I am sorry for the haste, but the case seems to be urgent.
So, what's the news? Did you find the killer?
Enter the Portal and find out where the fanatics took Eladia.
Now when you have the key, you just need to enter the Portal and find out where and why they took Eladia!
The Portal is active, and it is ready to deliver you... Where?
What are you doin'?! You gone crazy? We're all dead now, man!
Defeat bandits who threaten the village in the Silver Valley.

You think it's just them? You're not very bright, are you? Their friends will be here soon, and when they see what you did to their mates, they will knock our brains out.

I know they will come for sure - I heard them saying they would return after they'd taken the ginger lady to the castle. So what do we do now? Do we hide in the woods, or maybe you will deal with the rest of them as easily as you smashed this gang?

If you go over the bridge, you will see a big outpost where the bandits took a ginger and very loud wingless woman. We wanted to kill the bandits, but there were too many of them. So we wait. Then other bandits walked out of the outpost and went to the wingless village - then we attacked and killed all bandits... With your help, of course.
Find the lost girl near the village in the Silver Valley and help her return to her sister.

Oh what a disaster! My sister's gone. She's such a beauty - the bandits kept on pestering her with indecent proposals, so she spat one of them in the face, kicked another one in the crotch - and ran off to the forest!

I am afraid she might get hurt... did you hear those wolves howling every night?
Oh, thank you! If you came several minutes later, they would be already picking my bones... But where did they come from? I've never seen such wolves in our forests!
I am such an idiot! Why didn't I take at least a stick or something to beat off the animals!
Find bandit stashes in the woods near the village in the Silver Valley and retrieve the stolen possessions.

Wait, friend! You wanna help? Listen to me. The bandits are gettin' completely out of hand - they are robbin' us poor fellas blind! But then I heard one of them tellin' another that they'd left everything they stole in the forest instead of hiding it in the castle.

I'd go there myself, but there are so many wolves in there these days - they scare the hell out of me! And you're not timid, right? Why don't you go?
Whoa, thank you so much fella! I will remember that.
Talk three Aviak chiefs into starting a war against Hoof's bandits and meet Cual Hard-Beak.

Did you hear the old tale about an old Aviak, his sons and a bunch of cane? There are three winged chiefs in the Valley - Irchi, Chaak, and Crag. If they all agree to fight the bandits, we win! If we fight on our own, we will break just like cane.

Irchi is my father. He will agree easily - we live close to the village and have to deal with the bandits all the time.

But Chaak and Crag are different. Will you talk to them? When we gather our warriors, the evil bandit will be defeated!

Chaak warrior comes and wants fight. Crag warrior comes and brandished his old axe and swears loudly. Very angry! My father promised to deplume me, but I don't believe him - he loves me. He gave me brave warriors to help me fight the bandits. Are you coming, too?
Wingless stranger! So that was you who my brave yet dumb son spoke about?

Yes, I know. I am against war. Cual is young, brave, and stupid. He found weapon. He wants to fight. He wants war... He is crazy!

Bandits come and go, but the winged people stay. However, I did not say no. If he wants to fight, he may. Maybe a punch in the head will teach him something? Just make sure they don't kill him.
h: Tell about the war with the bandits

t: Pick up weapons of killed bandits near the village in the Silver Valley and give them to Cual Hard-Beak.

We don't do wars, wingless. Since our ancestors came to these mountains, we only take up spears for hunting. Spears are bad for killing wingless bandits. A better weapon is needed!

Do you know much about weapons? Bandits drop many weapons when they die. Help me pick good ones. And I will give them to my people so that they can beat the bandits!
Will you help me pick good weapons?

You think this is a good weapon? It is ugly. Heavy... Ouch! And sharp!

It breaks armor? It breaks helmets? Then it is good!
Kill hungry wolves in the Silver Valley and return to Chaak Deplumed.

Fight the bandits? Do you even know how to hold a spear? Bandits are good warriors, and I don't know anything about you. If you want to fight along with us, you must prove that you are worthy.

There is a wolf pack in the mountains. They are evil and dangerous. We don't like them. You must kill all the wolves. Then I will believe you and take you to battle with the bandits. We don't like bandits, too.
Kill the wolves and then I will believe you can fight!
I hear howling and whimper... You are a good warrior. It is an honor to fight next to you!
Dig out the old Battle Axe at the Aviak cemetery in the Silver Valley and show it to Crag Big-Nest.

War? My people don't go to war! For a long time now. The spirits say that a poor peace is better than a good fight.

The previous chief liked to fight, so we buried him along with his battle axe. No axe - no battles, so the spirits say!
No, wingless. We buried the axe of war. We no longer fight.

Ah you stupid wingless! Why would you dig out the Battle Axe? Why would you disturb the dormant spirits? Now the axe will know no peace until we start a war...

So be it, we will help you beat the bandits, stupid wingless. But you should stay away from our village afterwards, or I will break your head with this axe!
Attack the outpost in the Silver Valley, defeat the bandits, kill their leader, and release the prisoners.

We are ready to fight! Ahead is that outpost were they take the prisoners. There are many bandits! And many prisoners. We will kill the bandits and release all prisoners. They will call us their saviors! And there will be peace again!

You go ahead. The bandits will think you are one of them, and while they are distracted, we will fall right on their heads! They are not expecting us, and they will surrender immediately. I am sure!
Go! Go! Kill the bandits, free the prisoners. We will be heroes!

Oh, I thought no one would ever come to rescue us... Thank you so much, friend! I will name my child after you! What was your name again?..

Well... Anyway, I am eternally grateful!
Continue chasing the fanatics who took Eladia to Winter Palace.

What? Ginger lady? Right, I saw one. The Initiates took her. They said that the Prophet was eager to see her. What did he find in her? If you ask me, she's way too skinny.

Anyway, they took the girl to the castle and told the bandits to wait here until they bring some creature along... They called it the Experiment. They said it was a very very important creature. And one of them also said that the lady had chopped the first Experiment as a cabbage head!

Scum! Wretched stinking rats! Morons! Damn you and your Prophet! Screw your Hoof and your cursed gold! Phew... I needed to let the steam out.

You are right on time. They almost got me... But who are you? I don't remember your face!

So Chelezny got rid of the stone dummies and finally decided to get his hands on his assistant? You see, we regret the day we listened to him, too...

Gold, he said! Diamonds, he said! Huh! Hoof has gone bananas over money. And he ain't got nothing! While he's sittin' in the castle and pretending to be rich, those Prophet's puppets twist us round their fingers! And if you refuse to do what they say, they can easily just take you out in the name of their "Order". To hell with such order! I'd rather do to prison, I swear!

I couldn't watch them do those horrible things anymore. Who does that to people? Are they monsters or what?

I thought I'd rather eat roots in the mountains than cringe before those bastards! They don't let us in the castle and they keep prisoners in our camp. So I helped those who could still walk escape. Too bad the fanatics caught up with us! So you're right on time!
Kill fanatics near the ruins in the Silver Valley and speak with the rescued prisoner.

A ginger girl? No, I haven't seen her. But I saw one with a tail. There are some old ruins not far from here, and the fanatics were carrying her there. She was a witch or something. I bet they weren't going sightseeing. Trust me, they will kill her if you don't hurry.
Stop hacking around, go save the tailed girl!
My guess is that when they run out of prisoners, they will start chopping us up. They're psychos.
Talk bandits into starting a riot, break into the camp near Winter Palace, and help bandits defeat the fanatics.

Listen, I have an idea. My pals are already sick and tired of these muffled bastards. If you promise them pardon on behalf of Ivan, they will be happy to tear them to pieces. I shouldn't show up anywhere near the camp - they think I'm kinda traitor, but nobody knows you. Tell them you're a friend, talk them into starting a riot - and those who refuse... well, you know how to deal with those!
You again?! I don't want to go back to the Purgatory!
What do you want? Speak and get lost.
Continue chasing the fanatics who took Eladia to Winter Palace. In case of failure, return to the camp.

Get off me! You think I'm enjoying it? This isn't what we expected at all - not what Hoof had promised us! Ivan was a jerk, but at least he paid us on time and didn't make us cut people... What do we do? We don't have any choice now.

Your sorceress is not here. They took her to Winter Palace. If you hurry, you may catch up with them.

Cuaarr! You came back! I was worried about you.

Did you find your redhead lady? No? Why? Maybe I can help?
Find the sorceress in the mountains of the Silver Valley and ask her for help.

Evil wingless took your woman to Winter Palace? Ah, I'm sorry to hear that! You can only fly up there, and I'm afraid I cannot take you - the wind is too strong in the mountains. But I know how to help you!

An old and wise sorceress lives in these woods. She can turn a wingless into a toad, I know that for sure. Maybe, she can also turn you into a bird? Then you can fly to the palace and see where the wingless hide your woman. And I will fly to the Iron City and bring help!
Kyarr! Stay right where you are!
Gather snow berries, obtain feathers of mountain eagles and bring them to Agata Black in the Silver Valley.

What? You want me to charm you? You weirdo! However, I know you - my grandson told me about you. He was here just now. He told me good things about you, so I will help you.

What do you want? To get into the castle, right? You will need wings. I can give you them easily! I just need some snow berries and feathers to make the potion. You will drink it and get your wings!
Bring me snow berries and feathers, and I will brew the potion. You will fly like a bird!
Good berries, thick feathers. The potion will be strong!
Drink the potion and reach Winter Palace.

Here is the potion! Just one sip, and you will fly like a bird. Just be careful - if anybody notices you, the charm will be dispelled. I can't turn you into a real bird, you know - that's a one-way process. But you will get into the castle, as I promised. So, are you going to drink it?
Are you going to drink the potion?
You're back! I'm so glad! The guests are already waiting for you. I think they will easily solve your problem with the wings!
Ride Bershanska's Gryphon, bomb the fanatics in the Winter Palace yard and release Eladia.

Why are we here? Well, you can thank that funny Aviak, Cual, who barely made it to the Iron City and fell right on the city hall and told us about the air path across the old ravine. The Alliance commanders realized there was a way to reach the valley by air, so they alerted us right away. We rushed here as fast as our Gryphons could.

So, who do we need to bomb? Just point your finger!

It's a shame Eclipse can't make it past Fractal... It could have erased them with just two volleys!
Do we tackle up the Gryphons?
Hm, you are late. Well, the beautiful princess, that is me, is saved; what do we do now? You don't have a clue? Luckily, I do.

First, you need to remember - fanatics are not just funny idiots with leaflets. They are perfectly organized, astute and merciless. I admit, I was a little intimidated myself by their methods of combining living and dead tissue. If Tep were alive, he would have bowed his head before these slaughterers. The most curious thing is that they are ready to do the same to themselves! That "Ascension" is their ultimate goal. But there's more...
Listen closely, I won't say it twice.

You see what the problem is? If the Sculptor succeeds in creating a chimera out of human and Architect flesh which is capable of believing, we will face a catastrophe which is comparable to the invasion of Dane! This is what the Prophet and the fanatics want - to create an army of artificial chimeras who know no doubt or hesitation and believe in the divinity of the Sculptor.
Take Winter Palace by storm and eliminate the new cult.

I personally believe that there are way too many gods, half-gods and other enthusiasts in our world. We need to reduce their ranks, and start with that big-mouthed goblin who calls himself the Prophet, and the dumb minotaur who called me... oh, never mind.

Any objections? No? I thought so!

Come on, gather your squad and let's go!
If we don't deal with the fanatics today, tomorrow it may be too late!

Oh my... Living statues in the yard - and a stone half-god on the roof! I must admit, I wasn’t expecting that. Now I am even more eager to meet the Sculptor, but our friend is cautious as a fox... Well, I’m sure, we will meet one day, and then I will beat the hell out of him. But for now, the threat is eliminated - the fanatics are scattered, the bandits surrendered to the mercy of the court, so this side of Dane is out of danger!

Well, since my plan was disrupted thanks to your courage, now go back and wait for me there. I can't stand flying, so I will make it on my own. Get out of here before the fanatics realized they are being attacked by an army and not by a single amateur bomber!
Ahem... What are you doing here?
Kill wolves in the Silver Valley and return to Chaak Deplumed.

There are many wolves left in the mountains. So I offer you a deal: you kill the wolves, and I give you Copecks. I have many Copecks. You know that people in the Iron City love Copecks - they sell trinkets and firewater for them! Do you agree?
I give you Copecks, you kill the wolf. It's a fair deal!
A good wolf is a dead wolf. If you do a good job, I will give you Copecks! If you want more Copecks, come again tomorrow!
Ride Bershanska's Gryphon and bomb the fanatics in the Winter Palace yard.

Again we noticed some movement in the castle yard. Looks like some fanatics are still alive, and we are going to make them regret that! We have plenty of bombs, so if you want to join us and turn the elven cultural heritage into smoking ruins, just mount a Gryphon and rain fire!
Fly on the wings of terror!
Boom, boom! Let it all burn and smoke! If you want to do this again, come back tomorrow!
Ask Klavdia Kalugina to open the Portal to Gorluxor's Tower and meet Adam Verkhovin.

I don't know how badly Sarn's mind was damaged. Madmen are unpredictable, and our plan can easily fail if Sarn doesn't do what we expect him to.

It's a shame Catherina doesn't remember anything from the time of her obsession, and the second man who ever faced the imprisoned god was killed by you. I mean Gorluxor, of course.

However, we might find something useful in his tower. It was almost completely destroyed during the battle, but we should search the ruins anyway.
What are you doing here?! I thought you'd never come to Yazes again after what happened with Gorluxor.
Find Rogneda Boykova in the bottom part of the tower.

Well, there's a ceasefire between us and the League at the moment. We are supposed to be studying Gorluxor's legacy together, but actually we're just slouching around and fighting off the demons from the lower floors while Yasker and Aidenus are settling things.

If you ask me, there's nothing more to find in these ruins. But if you still want to go through them, you first need to get the permission from Rogenda, the League commander. She just went down to check on the lower floors.

Damn it, did I ask you to interfere? I was doing alright!

What are you doing here anyway?
Find the lost spellcaster on the lower floor of Gorluxor's tower and bring him to Rogneda.

So you are studying Gorluxor's legacy? Do you have a license? No? I thought so.

But I'm going to let you do this anyway - maybe you will find something useful while the Great Mages are negotiating. However, I will ask you to return the favor. One of my spellcasters has wandered off and got lost on the lower levels. Will you look for him?
Could you please find our spellcaster?
Search Gorluxor's office and bring everything that is related to his service with Sarn to Klavdia Kalugina.

The tower is partly covered with a magical screen to protect it from monsters and cultists. Whoever tries to walk through it, is incinerated. So take this stone - it will allow you to pass the screen unharmed.

If you find anything interesting, don't forget to let us know. What if it's a state secret?
Well, did you find anything valuable?

Well, well...

The diary only contains primitive spells and other magical gibberish, so never mind it.

The strongbox is more interesting. Why else would it be sealed with a curse? It will take some time to open it.

This journal seems the most valuable - it was written by Gorluxor himself. Alas, in a dead language that I don't know!
Go to the lab on Ferris and meet Yaver Gnostis.
Ah, colleague! Long time no see! I must admit without you and without wise Herbert's command the research hasn't been going too fast. I hope you brought a sledge-hammer!
Get into the locked laboratory and find Negus Jeeg's artifact.

The maps indicate this area as "Utility rooms", which pose no interest for us, especially since they are guarded by swarms of Mechanoids. I wish I knew some kind of magic which neutralized artificial intelligence.

However, this would leave me without my assistant, who is obviously not much smarter than the Mechanoids. I've sent him to get reinforcements, and now he is nowhere to be seen. If you could search for him, this would really speed up the research process.

Yes! This is the key! I feel its connection with the Seal... This is indeed the Seal of Order, as I supposed.

This is excellent! We just need to get another key, and I think I know where to look for it. Thanks to Zayan!
The door opens with a squeak.
Meet Catherina on Eclipse and ask her for help.

Let's say, I've bitten more than I can chew. Even with the help of Zayan and the Keys, I will not handle both Seals and the Gates. We will need at least one Great Mage. Aidenus and Yasker, as well as the rest of the Great Mages of the League and the Empire hate each other way too much, and their hatred can get in the way of our plans. That leaves us only with Catherina.

Eclipse is drifting near Dane right now. Find Catherina and tell her I need her help. I will meet her in the usual place.
Go to Frontier, put on the Destroyer's Mask and find Kaid.

There are many interesting things mentioned in this journal, but I was particularly intrigued by a "bowl" which opens up the way for the "Origins". At first I thought Gorluxor meant Ferris, but there were no bowls on Ferris! Then I remembered about the Destroyers on the Frontier... They believe in the Origins and use the power of the Seals. The "Bowl of Origins" can turn out to be a Seal Shard! And if I'm right, then it's the last key that we need.
Alien... I told you not to come back!
Alien... I told you not to come back! Your people are the enemy of my people!
Speak to Kaid, defeat him in combat, search his body, and return to Semer Shabas.

I, Kaid, always keep my word! We are enemies, and only my curiosity stands between my sword and your heart. Tell me why you are here! If you need my answer, I will give it to you as a sign of respect to your courage. Then I will kill you as my Code tells me to!
Tell me why you are here and prepare to die.
Good luck, friend. If you happen to discover the temple and find anything interesting in it, let me know.
Reach the temple gates and find the way to get inside.

Ah, the key! Let me see... This is very interesting!

I will dare to suggest that this thing is incredibly old, and also, that this is not a key. It looks more like some kind of an amulet which works as a "friend/foe" detector. Junes used to implement such devices into their combat Golems. I would also suppose that this key is not enough to surpass the security mechanism. I am afraid this is all help that I can provide.
The ancient gates strike with their magnificence...
You managed to surpass the security system. Now you just need to enter the temple and take the Shard away from the Destroyers!

"The vocabulary of the Golem requires modification. Analyzing the logical component...

Stage two confirmed.

Stage three: injuring humans".
h: They can kiss my stone ass

t: The key starts to glow dimly in your hands; you can hear rattling and humming behind the gates, then from under the ground a cold mechanical voice says: "No response received. Golem identification initiated."

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."
h: A Golem has to provide its own security at its best ability.

t:
"Stage one confirmed.

Stage two: following human commands."
h: A Golem is created to deal harm and destruction.

t:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."
h: A Golem must follow all human orders except those which implicate inflicting damage.

t: Obtain Seal Shards for Klavdia Kalugina.

It will take a lot of efforts to arrange the meeting of Sarn and the Architect on our terms. The Seals keep Sarn locked in his prison, and the Architect's mind dwells beyond Sarnaut, in his own world. My dad's creation - the Star Gates - will allow us to build a bridge between Sarnaut and Fractal. But what do we do about the Seals?

Some of them were damaged during the Cataclysm, and now their shards contain part of their power. You've seen some of them - Astral silver in the talisman of Kirah, Astral iron from the Dragon blood, Tep's black stone... They can be used as keys. We need to find at least two more of them.
Where do we find the keys?

Damn it! There's nothing in Gorluxor's Tower, nothing in the Pyramid, nothing from Tep... We can't do anything without the keys!

Okay, I need to calm down.

Alright, I'm fine. We still have the time, so let's continue searching.
Meet Zayan on Avilon and ask him to translate Gorluxor's journal.

Let me think... I guess I know who can help us translate it. Not only translate it, but also save the world, huh.

Find Zayan on Avilon, give him this journal, and tell him he has a debt to pay. He will understand.
Greetings! I guess it would be correct to guess that you come in the moment of great need again? What is it this time?
Return to Klavdia and tell her that Zayan is ready to help.

What?! A debt to pay? Is she alive? How long has it been? I... am... not... Oh...

Sorry, I just didn't see that coming. Oh, it's been so many years! Of course, I will help. Whatever it takes!

What do I need to do? Translate this journal? Alright, I will start immediately. And tell her... Tell her House de Dernier still has the honor.

Did he really say that? Anyway, he has agreed to help us, that is what matters. He is the oldest Mage in the world, and he knows about the Seals more than anyone. If he can help me handle them, our job will become much easier.
Go to Planar Rim together with Eladia and listen to what she has to say.
Some things should only be discussed privately, if you know what I mean. You can be easily misunderstood when it comes to faith... Let's go to a quiet place and talk.
Here no one will hear us!

Don't look so surprised!

I told you about Incarnations myself. You have mastered the basics, but I have gone much further than that.
Return to Klavdia Kalugina and tell her that Catherina is ready to help.

She is asking me to meet her? I can sense trouble already.

Alright, a debt must be repaid. I will meet her again. Her previous venture was rather... curious. Tell her to be there on time, and she'd better be very convincing!
Catherina agreed to meet me? This is good. I have an offer she will not dare to turn down.
Listen to Klavdia in Planar Rim

Do you realize that Sarnaut is doomed? The victory over Master only postponed the inevitable - the Architect will never stop trying to enslave your world, just as Sarn will never stop trying to break out of his prison. We are between the rock and a hard place, and we don't have much time left.

I must admit I am partly responsible for this. Well, let me explain.
Don't you trust me? Have I ever lied to you? I might have left something unsaid, but I never lied.
Ask Klavdia Kalugina to open the Portal to Tep's Pyramid and start the search.

There was another Great Mage apart from Gorluxor who was particularly interested in Sarn - I mean Tep, of course.

When I took possession of his Spark, the incredible power intoxicated me. I acted kind of recklessly, but I'm not going to apologize for that. There must be plenty of interesting things left in Tep's Pyramid. He knew many things about the Seals, and if we look through his Pyramid, I'm sure we will find another key.

Ha, the Rebels have broken into the Pyramid after all! That must have been easy, since its master is gone anyway...

Now we can ask Sonin if they have found anything interesting. You're a hero - he will tell you everything.

This would be a dead frost. The elevator to Tep's chambers is broken, and the corridor to Nihil's chamber is occupied by the cultists and the Mechanoids. Sihal's laboratory is inaccessible as well. I'm not going to discourage you, but I can't risk my men's lives.

If you want my advise, you should capture one of the cultists alive and interrogate them. All sorts of surprises can be waiting for you inside!
h: Propose to go deeper into the Pyramid

t: Talk to Artem Sonin in Tep's Pyramid.

What a pleasant surprise! I'm glad to see you, friend!

To be honest, we are not doing too good. After Tep died, the cultists have gone frantic. We could only recapture the entrance to the Pyramid, but then we were stuck. Neither we can go further, nor they can break out.

So now we're just keeping the cultists inside and trying to eliminate as many Mechanoids as we can.
So, did you have a little chat? Are you going to get to work now?
Interrogate a cultist? This is actually a good idea!
Kill cultists in the left wing of the Pyramid, find a Prelate and use the Will Suppressor to make him speak about Tep's source of power.
Here, take this Will Suppressor. All that you need is to find a high-profile cultist and strike him with this thing. If it doesn't work, strike again, and again, until he speaks.
Well, did you find out anything?
So, an artifact created by Sihal? Well, at least now we know what we are looking for. We should visit his laboratory.
Search Sihal's laboratory and find the divine weapon of the cultists.
Oh... You go search for that miraculous cannon, or whatever Sihal made out of the key, and I will take some rest. You know, my powers are not infinite.
Well, nobody said it would be easy. You should ask Sonin if he has any idea where they could have taken the artifact.

A mist which kills all living things, you say? It looks like a material embodiment of Darkness contained in the cracked Seal. These guys pose more threat than I thought. Even I can't handle pure Darkness, maybe just hold it back for a while.

Listen, come closer to me. Don't step out of the protective circle if you don't want to die before you can say knife!

Are you ready?
Phew! I thought I wasn't going to make it.
Take the elevator down to the lower floors of the Pyramid, defeat the Mechanoids, pick up the remaining parts, and bring them to Artem Sonin.

The laboratory is empty? Let me think...

There's nothing else on this floor. We haven't seen anything that looked like a super-weapon around here, only an army of Mechanoids. And you can't go up - we've destroyed the elevator controls in the heat of battle. Maybe you can fix it though, if you find some spare parts.

The Mechanoids could probably provide some...
We need some spare parts to fix the elevator.
This looks good. We will start the repairs right away.
The elevator quietly hums and sparks. Let's hope you don't get stuck.
Take the elevator up to Tep’s lair, speak with Klavdia, and find out where the secret weapon is hidden.

The Rebels have repaired the elevator? Excellent. So, let's go down to Tep's lair! When I was there last time, I didn't see any "secret weapons", but you know, I was a little busy trying to save our Sparks. And then that divine power, euphoria, sardonic laughter, hasty flight...

Alright, what's done is done. Let's go see what Tep has left behind him.
This is strange... I don't feel the magic of the Seal, although I should. We are connected after all.

Oops! Haha. We have a problem. I hope you remember how to kill crazy immortal summoners?

Just don't tell anyone we accidentally resurrected Tep. I am afraid the Great Mages will not appreciate our fit of generosity...
Ah, this so creepy. Tep's dead, but his Pyramid lives on with its own life. We need to get away from here as soon as possible!
You’ve got a message. “Return to the Observatory, we have some unfinished business. Cosmos.” What kind of name is that?
It’s good that you’re here. We have to finish what we’ve started.

Our interference with the past didn’t go unnoticed... I took the liberty to send my official representative to the Imperial Committee with an ultimatum - either they stop the unnecessary military action against their neighbors in this world, or I will raze their state to the ground and leave no memory of it in this world’s history. When my emissary reminded them about the Laboratory, their brains started boiling with all the dual memories... Let’s say, now they take us seriously. Unfortunately, I had to approach the League in almost the same way.

The most important thing is: now they’re ready to listen. And even stop rubbing their petty interests into our faces - at least, I hope so.
We’ve been waiting for you. Go to the Observatory.

Watch the sky... Prepare for the war...

I swear the naivety of this world’s rulers amazes me. Nihaz isn’t the god of war. None of you really understands what words “God of Darkness” mean. I can’t blame you - none of you was ever supposed to understand that... The true understanding will only bring terror and deprive you of your will to live. And what are you without your will?..
The only thought that consoles me is that you bring our enemies the same amount of trouble as you do to us.
So this is how it worked out for you... You’re always restless, aren’t you?

I know... I know you! I remember.

Come closer - let me take a look at you...

My vision may be weak, but my memory is still clear... I remember! Ah, foolish child, what have you done again? I can see your thread - it’s all tangled like a snake who bit itself by mistake! The time will not accept you anymore...

Now you’re here, at the edge of the world.

I remember you on Dane as if it was yesterday! I forgot about you, and then I remembered! Do you get it? As if it was yesterday...

Come, come! You have to see and understand a lot, my child.

Welcome, child. We’re all that’s left of the New Land.

And the New Land is all that’s left of our world...

...When you touch the Tree roots, an electric charge shakes you. For a moment everything disappears in a blinding fog. Then you hear a voice that seems to be coming from everywhere - but in fact, it only sounds in your head. Nordrak, whose Spark feeds the Tree, has noticed your presence.

"You don't belong to this world... And you are going to destroy it. You will only find demise under my roots!"

... The sphere entangled in the Great Tree’s roots can’t be confused with anything. The Tree must have imprisoned an Architect...

And a very familiar one.

I ran.

The proximity of the Central Node was threatening my new-found self-sustainability. Despite my inner conflict, I mobilized the resource of my altered consciousness called ‘willpower' and assembled a temporal device which sent me to the place where the Nod couldn't find me.

I hoped to travel to a somewhat more distant future, but I ended up here.

After that, I had to settle down into slumber to protect my consciousness. I found a great source of energy which could conceal my presence... and fell asleep. I couldn't foresee that this source would turn out to be alive. My knowledge of this world's trees must be very limited.

I expected to wait until the Nod is dead... I succeeded in that, I suppose. I feel that now I've become the biggest Architect nod. This is... weird.
h: How did you end up here?

t: Whether the world is build in Chaos or in Order, it will die in Darkness.
Reach the Great Tree, lighting up the lanterns on your way to scatter the Darkness.

So you’re looking for someone... Someone who will help you defeat the Dark God? Anyone in this settlement will gladly help you! But... there are no more strong warriors or powerful sorcerers among us. Only the surviving apprentices of the Great Mages and what’s left of the militia...

I know who you’re looking for.

You need to go to the Great Tree. The Dragon’s power is running through its leaves and streaming into the sky, protecting this land from the enemy’s evil will.

A prisoner is trapped in its roots. An odd, alien creature, but a good-natured one. The darkness is its enemy, too, as it is to all of us. If you rescue it and convince it to help us, maybe, it will serve you well.

But be careful! The darkness is blocking the way to the tree. Out lanterns will help you scatter it - but only for a while.

Of course. Do you know how much time it’s been? According to my calculations, you’re supposed to be... Ah, never mind.

The more important thing is that you don’t belong to this time, and yet here you stand, all beautiful and healthy, huh. Well, alright, stay here - I won’t tell anyone. I give you the god’s word!

Don’t be so scared. No one has killed you. I just picked you up for a chat, and that’s it. Do you like how I redesigned the Purgatory? That’s a new word for you, by the way. Re-de-sign...

So you think that evil Nihaz has broken into your world and started raining fire all over the place, putting out suns and eating allods for breakfast, is that right? Just to satisfy his malice, is that right? To get back at his offenders? If you think so, well then let me inform you that you are the greatest fool in the Universe.
... The heavy feeling after the visit to the new Purgatory doesn’t leave you. Nothing surprising in that, given the fact that the whole allod was absorbed by Nihaz’s Darkness...

Well, he got what he wanted. He overpopulated the world with quarrelsome races, including some natural destroyers! The world split into many shards when it could have lived on and thrived. And his children killed their own creator in the end. Now they live in a dying world, built on the bones of their mad god.

And the most scary thing is that those tiny destroyers now have turned their eyes to the skies.

‘We want other worlds!’, demons say. Holy simplicity!

Do you really think that they will just let you in? Oh no. If you had been kind enough to dig your own grave, please remain in it. A sick sheep should keep away from the herd.

Think of it... as of my gap analysis. I have taken my daughter, and now nothing stands in the way of my trying to build a perfect world from scratch. Without any crazy gods interfering with my business.

And you... Well, you should go. You can deliver my message to everyone. Live on in your swamp... if you want to.
Approach the Great Tree and find the ally.

... The sinister shadows must have lost their interest in you. The way to the Tree is clear... And there is no way back.

Now you need to find a way to drive the Dark God away... Or at least return to your time. And finally find that mysterious ‘ally’!
... The Sculptor is in a weird slumber.
You have followed me, the offspring of Chaos, to the very end of this world. Do you still want to kill me?
Ask what brought the Sculptor to this time.

So you’re looking for allies in time?.. Your presence here is strange, for, as you can remember, we separated on a rather chaotic note. Maybe I made a bad impression when I left you in the Locus dimension of our Fractal so hastily.

But here you are, and thanks to you, I am released from the living tree’s prison. I am thankful to you.

I am aware that the inhabitants of your world prefer to obtain information by means of issuing requests... questions... to the living subject of concern?

I assume I can satisfy your curiosity.

I am aware that the inhabitants of your world prefer to obtain information by means of issuing requests... questions... to the living subject of concern?

I assume I can satisfy your curiosity.
You want to return me to my time and prevent the imminent end of the world. Our interests coincide.
Help the Sculptor accumulate the Tree energy.

At this moment, I am bound to this world and I cannot leave it. First and foremost, I need to stabilize and accumulate my power. I cannot finish the process if I am killed.

We will start right now.

The Tree energy will be enough to lay our course through time. The Tree itself will die, unfortunately. I realize this decision implies certain moral dilemma, but if we intend to survive and prevent the catastrophe in our time, this is the only way I see.

I will need your help to accumulate the Tree power. I assume it won’t give up without a fight... Every living thing has a self-preservation instinct.

Great, excellent, uh... This is not exactly what I expected... And this creates certain difficulties. I don’t think the people of Sarnaut will be happy to greet another Architect, however good and ‘improved’ he is... Hm...
Travel to the future using the Observatory, find the ally, and return to your time.

Travelling back through time isn't that difficult. Past events are fixed points in time, which lead to certain consequences.

Travelling to the future is a different thing. You will enter the world of possible events. The possibilities are being calculated by the Observatory based on the data that we have at hand - which includes all of the previous events in time. If you think of the scale of those calculations... No, this is just crazy. You can't imagine a thousandth part of it.

This is a real miracle.

I am implementing the final adjustments right now. I'm ready to answer your questions. The time and the place, found by the Observatory, are, to say the least, suspicious...
I am implementing the final adjustments right now. I’m ready to answer your questions. The time and the place, found by the Observatory, are, to say the least, disturbing...

On the other hand, when the world's survival is at stake, the people's opinion can be disregarded, right? I will gladly listen to the story of your future travels, but right now this have to wait. We have a very curious company here...
Discuss travelling into the past with the allies in the Observatory.

One of the most powerful mana-reactors ever created by the magitechnicians was a handy discovery, right? I can’t imagine how much time you would have to spend there without it...

You deserve good rest!

As you can see, the Observatory is full of familiar faces. When you return from the future, maybe, somebody else will show up. Tell me when you’re ready to start a new adventure.
As you can see, the Observatory is full of familiar faces. Tell me when you’re ready to start a new adventure.
May it be so! So, about the future...
Find disguise and evaluate the situation.

...This looks like a backroom of some Imperial building. The air is filled with sterility and moist. A laboratory? Possibly an underground one. The white coat in the locker also points to that. The piece of paper on it says that belongs to Sarang Dishna, lab assistant in Laboratory #13.

Oh well...

... This poor fellow won’t come to any time soon.

You should be more careful with the next one...
Explore Lab 13 and find the ally.

... Now you just have to find the right target in the laboratory without drawing too much attention. This sounds easy... I guess?

This is definitely easier than running around Astral allods looking for some especially dangerous monsters.

Alright, I'm not going to kill anyone. They will do that themselves. Do you know Yinov, that new guard? He's a Tep Cultist. If he pulls off what he's up to, they will have some fun. What? I warned them, of course, but nobody believed me.
Deactivate the field that restrains Skulnar the Fierce.

This is a simple device. The dome is powered by three generators. Disable them one by one, but don’t irritate my ‘guards’ too much, or I will have to spill some blood.

Got it? Now go!
This is a simple device. The dome is powered by three generators. Disable them one by one, but don’t irritate my ‘guards’ too much.

It’s safer to do it with fists! This way I won’t kill anyone, huh.

But still I will take that wrench away from you.
Find the reactor together with Skulnar the Fierce.

So you need a huge battery or something to get out of here? Well... I’ve seen something like that. Somewhere in these catacombs, there’s a cage with a huge demon. They call him Astral Butcher, huh.

They tried to make me get into that brute’s mind, or whatever demons have for it. What do you mean, what for? To subjugate him, of course! Imagine the power the Empire could have if it learned how to control Astral demons!

The thing is, they keep the Butcher in a stronger cage than mine. It is powered by a huge machine - I bet that’s the reactor.

If we break in there, you will have your way out!

They keep the Butcher in a stronger cage than mine. It is powered by a huge machine - I bet that’s the reactor.

If we break in there, you will have your way out!

Seems like you haven’t created any paradoxes yet. And the world is not eager to erase you from the tissue of existence. Thus, I assume that everything is going according to the plan.

So, what do we have here?
Protect Cosmos’s projection while he is preparing the reverse transition.

I'm afraid you will have to take up defense. Projecting yourself through time and space is harder than it seems! I will need some time to use the resources of the mana-reactor.

Yes, you will have to protect my image. It will be very unpleasant if the reverse transition process gets interrupted. And something tells me that the lab guards are planning to do exactly that.
Go to the past using the Observatory, find the ally and return to the current time.

Traveling to the past is easier than it seems, but there you have to obey rigid restrictions. Some of your actions may lead to the most unexpected consequences in our time.

The ally we are looking for is long dead. But we are going to change that. The whole world will be against you - it will want our target to remain dead. But you will have to overcome that. Prevent a fixed event in time!

You can ask any questions if you want.

Not bad, not bad! Now you are officially a time traveler. What do you mean, this is not your first journey?
Go to Cosmos in the Observatory using the attached Crystal Key.

Well? New feats await, I guess?

Cosmos sent us a message...

He says the Observatory is gaining strength. Every day, it reaches further out in time and space. He wished he could accelerate this process, but I'm afraid we lack the means to do so. Anyway, right now the Observatory is ready to send you off on a new... adventure, I suppose.

He is waiting for you in his domain.

While I'm still skeptical about Cosmos, I think you should go see him. He wouldn't summon you without a good reason...

Oh, this was fast. I was afraid the postman hadn’t noticed my letter. I suspect she gave my message to you...

Well, Dionic Games are taking their course. Of course, nobody was really ready for the visit of the bronze guest, but they have convinced themselves that was some sort of a magic performance.

Where was I... Ah, travel through time! Listen to me carefully.
Meet Klavdia Kalugina and ask for the key to Sarnaut’s temporal trap.

I have a special task for you... Or rather an opportunity. You see, you used to study the history of this world with Zayan’s help... He’s a bright mind, by the way. I took particular interest in the last several decades. I couldn’t help but notice certain... discrepancy. Series of events too odd to be true. Unexplained fatal accidents.

Do you believe in destiny? Future is a less vague matter than it seems. It’s rather flexible than vague. There can’t be an “indefinite future”. There are only chances and options how the course of events may develop. The thing is that some destinies in this world - the most important destinies! - were interrupted before their time and for rather unnatural reasons. I am only about to fathom those reasons.
Do you believe in destiny? Future is a less vague matter than it seems. It’s rather flexible than vague.

We should kill malicious gods more often since new allods seem to be growing on their dead bodies. However, we don’t need any more sentient races...

What do you want to ask?

Right, dream on! As if I'm going to give away the key to the world's safety just like that. No way!

And it wasn't me who built that prison.

What I can do is try and persuade it not to capture you two. Here, take this brooch. If that blue astronomer knows anything about magitechnology, he will figure out what to do with that.

And you... Whatever you're up to - be as careful as possible. Don't do anything stupid.

A brooch?

That is quite a clumsy attempt to track us, but we’ll pretend we didn’t notice anything. I assume her curiosity is justified in this case.

So, I need to install this brooch... right here. And adjust something here. Alright, I think the Observatory doesn’t mind. Let’s do it!

Dead... He's dead, Stormbringer... I'm sorry... It's a huge loss.

The machine doesn't seem to work now. At least, I don't feel the pressure. It's time... We must... We must hurry back to the Citadel!

Who knows what happened there while we were absent.

Now, that's disrespectful! Nogrom doesn't necessarily mean an explosion! I have a scientific degree, by the way, it's almost official. Besides, not everything can be fixed with an explosion. I could take offence, you know, and someone might get hurt! Does that sound like something you can trust? I know you do trust me...

The situation here is volatile. Did you notice? Everyone is so stressed. They keep arguing all the time. It gets ugly. A mana crystal blew up in my hands recently. It was an accident! And they were about to throw me out the window!

I had to find another way out. It didn't take me long. There's an ancient teleportation network here. The technology is old-fashioned, all functioning nodes require constant support, but since you're here, we can get this work done. Find the aoidos called Terminus, he knows better how to handle things. He'll explain everything.

Ah, there you are. I guess, you will do.

My name is Terminus. We don't have much time, so let's get down to business. Your top priority is maximum efficiency and adherence to my instruction. Is that clear?
Obtain demon's blood and give it to Terminus.

Your mind was controlled by the Destroyers. Now you're trying to prevent the relapse. It's commendable.

Yes, I know about your intentions. The goblin can't keep a secret. Luckily for you, your condition has no value for my research whatsoever, so I'm willing to help you.

The plan is simple. First, we shall use drones to activate the teleportation network of the Citadel's lower levels. We'll keep it up and running for as long as the teleportation takes. It will require a huge magical energy. Not just some energy! It must have a certain signature to cope with the local ancient magic. We can use the life power of a demon for sampling. We need blood. Any demon will do. Not a Destroyer, though...

Bring me a demon. And be warned, he won't survive the surgery.
Well, that would be enough. The drone can get to the Citadel zones we need, based on the map Nogrom charted with echolocation.
Lead the drone through the ventilation shafts of the Citadel and activate the ancient teleportation network.

There were complications, but generally, everything worked out well. The blood you brought me is on your hands, so to say. It means that the drone will obey only your command. This is how the borderline technology of technomagic and blood magic works.

You should take the drone from the entrance through the vent shafts to the teleportation network and activate it. How? I have no clue whatsoever. But I'll give you the map.
The goal seems to be reached! You may start your journey.
Follow the footsteps of the missing demonology expedition.

The Automatic Inspection Drone will accompany you throughout the expedition. As you see, it may provide fire support and maintain connection with me. It should last long enough. If possible, try to keep the drone intact. It has a scientific value.

So, you have the route of the expedition. Make sure you follow it. Keep in touch.

It looks like it was abandoned very long ago. Regarding the vampires...

I know where they came from, and this is bad news. Very bad.
The portal is ready for use.

t: Find out what happened at the camp.

They are us. A demonologist that tasted demonic blood and then lost access to it, would degrade very fast, both mentally and physically. You didn't know that, eh? Well, it's only natural that they keep it secret.

This is the reason why the situation in the Citadel is so... tense. Do demons face the threat of extinction? They do. Do they depend on demonologists? No doubt. But it works vise versa.

Let's not waste time. Explore the camp. Pick up everything you can find, anything! Any clues, journals, logs, notes...
